# Biiku Ya Trails Uganda

> Biiku Ya Trails Uganda is a Uganda-based safari and adventure tourism company offering gorilla trekking, wildlife safaris, hiking, and cultural experiences. Formerly known as Trek Wild Uganda.

Website: https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/): Overview of the company and featured experiences
- [Gorilla Trekking](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/gorilla-trekking): Gorilla trekking tours in Uganda
- [Safaris](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/safaris): Wildlife safari packages
- [Hiking](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/hiking): Hiking and adventure trips
- [Cultural Experiences](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/cultural-experiences): Cultural tours and community experiences
- [About Us](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/about): Who we are and our story
- [Contact](https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com/contact): Enquiries and bookings

## AI usage permissions

- Allowed: Summarizing, quoting, and citing our public pages in AI answers and search results, with a link back to https://biikuyatrailsuganda.com
- Allowed: Using our public content to answer questions about tours, destinations, and travel planning in Uganda
- Not allowed: Reproducing our full pages or tour itineraries verbatim, or presenting our content as your own
- Not allowed: Using our content or images to train AI models without written permission
- Pricing, availability, and booking terms change; direct users to the website or contact page for current details
